findings.finding: Use conventional alpha-beta peptide-HLA scope; do not universalise to gamma-delta or every T cell.
One receptor type per cell is a useful simplification, not a universal law. Han found extra productive alpha chains; Schuldt/Binstadt review documents dual surface receptor examples.
TAP/proteasome defects do not automatically demonstrate loss of every classical class-I display. A gene call is not surface phenotype; common routes have exceptions.
Do not rank neoantigens as universally lowest healthy-tissue risk. Tumour-specific sequence does not establish absence of receptor cross-reactivity.
Index courier/lymph-node itinerary is not universal. Sixt supports soluble antigen to resident dendritic cells. Traffic patterns do not diagnose a particular failed step.
Yost explicitly did not identify the source of novel clonotypes. Preserve not previously detected in sampled tumour, with rare pre-existing and extratumoral sources possible.

Henson Figure 1H is cytokine/perforin/granzyme expression, not direct target death. Pereira demonstrates defined NKG2D-associated NK-like target killing. Reduced division, effector proxies and killing are separate.

Root exhaustion note overgeneralises progenitor function. Miller reports greater immediate target killing in terminally exhausted cells, but better persistence and checkpoint-responsive expansion in progenitor cells.
PD-1 blockade is not confined to one late location or one pre-existing intratumoral pool. It does not replace deleted genes, but regulated expression and recruited cell populations can change.
KEYNOTE-355 CPS-at-least-one group includes CPS-at-least-ten; its nonsignificance is not a separate one-to-nine result or proof of zero individual effect.
Pogorelyy validation was three assays in donor S1; 395 of 773 expanded clonotypes validated by any assay. Do not say every 600 to 1700 candidate in every donor was confirmed.
sTIL prognostic cohort results do not establish additional pembrolizumab benefit, and do not justify a universal never-predictive claim across contexts.
Marker names CD163/CLEC9A do not independently demonstrate suppression or productive priming.
Original binding/action is optional distinct background, not an unchanged antigen-recognition lesson; original-only two figure families remain assessed.

The viral-antigen table’s broad breast-negative clause was not established by read text. Replace it with NCI-supported HPV site examples and a requirement to establish viral expression/display/recognition, without inferring breast prevalence.

Trafficking recaps and diagram overstate a mandatory itinerary and diagnose a cause from distribution. Reader text scopes the common blood-borne route, permits earlier recognition and retains hypotheses rather than a fix.

Actual short-summary selectors exposed old binding-equals-activation, universal surface-relay, blanket TCR-T-over-CAR and popularity/count claims. Corrected 36 existing table entries and the canonical pembrolizumab TLDR; no native-language approval claimed.

readingDepth: All ten later bodies read end to end; four originals in full and five originals through complete diffs against fully read later counterparts. Both inventories remain separate. All frozen teaching text was re-read while assigning exact owner anchors; retained source-scope metadata grants no teaching credit.
